judged_text: The userId argument passed to refreshOAuthTokens is `credentialId`, not the user's id, so the sync endpoint receives a credential id as calcomUserId. The parent application looks up the wrong user (or no user) by credential id and returns wrong or missing tokens — every synced Zoho Bigin refresh operates on the wrong identity with no error surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path calls `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`, whereas `refreshOAuthTokens`’s third parameter is `userId` and is sent to the sync endpoint as `calcomUserId` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). Passing a credential identifier instead of `credential.userId` will cause the sync endpoint to receive the wrong user id and refresh tokens for the wrong/missing identity.
